builds.summary: Find a high-number candidate for Leverage apply and consumption in the specified finite setup; compare the competing stat package.

builds.hypothesis: Each passive packet is level-dependent base maxHP fraction+0.02% per AP. One attack applies, one ally hit consumes same fraction; AP/penetration support magic. Deathcap amplifies AP; Shadowflame supplies15 flat magic penetration/conditional lowHP magic-true amplification; Void supplies40% MR penetration; Banshee/Zhonya supply105 AP each; Riftmaker supplies HP-to-AP and verified8% combat ramp.

kitEvidence.formula:
Renata's Attacks mark enemies for [6] seconds and deal an additional [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=0.01, perLevel=0.0012, changes=[{"mLevel": 6, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 0.0013000000035390258, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 9, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.0013000000035390258, "__type": "Breakpoint"}]) + (0.0002) × AP] max Health magic damage if they were unmarked.

Allied champions' Attacks or Abilities consume the mark, dealing [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=0.01, perLevel=0.0012, changes=[{"mLevel": 6, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 0.0013000000035390258, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 9, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.0013000000035390258, "__type": "Breakpoint"}]) + (0.0002) × AP] max Health magic damage.

Renata may only have one target marked at a time.

builds.name: Loyalty Program: one ally shield
builds.summary: Investigate high one Loyalty Program shield on one ally output with a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high one Loyalty Program shield on one ally output with a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: E grants 50/65/80/95/110 + 0.5 AP shield for three seconds to an ally hit. Its pair of missiles and final area do not automatically mean two full shield layers. Enemy damage uses a separate 65/95/125/155/185 + 0.55 AP helper.

ceiling.targetName: one Loyalty Program shield on one ally
ceiling.finiteState: Level 18, selected ability maximum learned rank unless explicitly overridden, minute 30. Recipient ally: 3000 maximum HP, 100 armor and 50 MR. Owner HP 100%, target HP 30%, observation 3s. No dragons, elixirs or allied stat buffs. Record actual AD/AP, HP and resist modifiers; Gathering Storm at minute 30 if selected. No free permanent stacks. Stop damage at death, cap healing at recipient missing HP, and report raw output separately. Seraph transformed. One E cast passes through one ally at 30% health with no prior shield, recipient items or allied buffs. Record initial shield capacity after the real contact; any caster self-shield and other allies are separate recipients. Dawncore conversion read from actual purchased regeneration.
